rationale: Three sensors (door_back, motion_living, win_bed) went offline at the same second (21:14:02–03) while the base station remained online with normal uplink and healthy RSSI history (-54 to -65 dBm). The log shows E-610 (radio module self-test warning), which per KB policy with multiple simultaneous peripheral drops must always be escalated to FAE. This matches historical case H-05 (radio module replaced). The door_back 8% battery is a separate L1 issue and cannot explain the other two sensors (71% and 66%) dropping together.
